items.title: Fake Browser Update Pages Are Stealing Passwords
items.summary: That "Install Browser Update" Page Is a Trap.

items.title: Microsoft November 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes 1,235 flaws including Outlook zero-day — update at Settings > Windows Update
items.summary: Microsoft released its November 2026 Patch Tuesday on November 10 fixing a record 1,235 vulnerabilities including one actively exploited Outlook zero-day (CVE-2026-124194) that steals NTLM authentication hashes when a malicious message file is opened. Update now at Settings > Windows Update > Check for updates.

items.title: LibreOffice 26.2.7 is the stable free office suite that opens every file — download at libreoffice.org
items.summary: LibreOffice 26.2.7 released November 3, 2026 is the mature stable branch recommended for all users. It opens Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF files free with no subscription. Download at libreoffice.org/download.

items.title: Clearwave Fiber brings 100% fiber internet to Lake City with symmetrical speeds — check availability at clearwavefiber.com
items.summary: Clearwave Fiber offers 100% fiber internet in Lake City with plans from 300 Mbps to 7 Gbps, symmetrical upload/download speeds, no contracts, no data caps, and local tech support. Check your address at clearwavefiber.com/address-search.

items.title: 7-Zip 26.06 is the free file archiver that opens RAR, ISO, ZIP and 7z — download at 7-zip.org
items.summary: 7-Zip 26.06 released November 6, 2026 is a free, open-source file archiver with high compression, AES-256 encryption, and support for 7z, ZIP, RAR, ISO, and dozens more formats. Download at 7-zip.org/download.html (1.6 MB for 64-bit Windows).

items.title: Bitwarden free password manager stores unlimited passwords and passkeys — sign up at bitwarden.com
items.summary: Bitwarden's free plan offers unlimited password storage, cross-device sync, passkey support, and breach monitoring. Create a free account at bitwarden.com/go/start-free/ and download apps for Windows, Mac, Linux, iOS, Android, and browser extensions.

items.title: Fake QR Codes on Parking Meters Steal Your Money and Data
items.summary: Scammers are pasting fake QR code stickers over the real ones on parking

items.title: One USB stick for every ISO — Ventoy boots them all free without reformatting
items.summary: Ventoy is free at ventoy.net — install it on a USB drive, copy as many ISO files as you want (Windows, Linux, rescue disks), and boot into a clean menu to pick which one to run. No reformatting between ISOs.

items.title: Windows has a free remote help tool built in — Quick Assist connects you safely
items.summary: Quick Assist is built into Windows 11 — press Start, type Quick Assist, and open it to get a 6-digit code for someone you trust to help you remotely. No download, no account, no third-party tool.

items.title: Free portable tool stops Windows tracking cold — O&O ShutUp10++ puts every privacy switch in one window
items.summary: O&O ShutUp10++ is free at oo-software.com — download the portable version, run it, and click "Apply recommended settings" to block Windows telemetry, data collection, and advertising IDs in one click.

items.title: Stop struggling with the Snipping Tool — ShareX is the free screenshot and screen recorder that does it all
items.summary: ShareX is free at getsharex.com or the Microsoft Store — install it, press Print Screen, and capture any region, window, scrolling page, or screen recording with annotations, arrows, and text in seconds.

items.title: Stop paying for Microsoft Office — LibreOffice is the free alternative that opens every file
items.summary: LibreOffice is free at libreoffice.org — download the installer for Windows, Mac, or Linux and it opens Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files without a subscription, no account, and no forced AI features.
